author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The more I use AI, the more reminds me this Chinese old proverb

When wisdom is called for, one laments the learning left undone;
Until the road is traveled, one knows not the hardship of the journey.

original text: 書到用時方恨少，事非經過不知難

comments.text:
Yes, this is why I tell my sons that they should be thankful to even receive a lesson. Every lesson is a gift.

What fortune to be able to learn.

Many people did not do this prior to chatbots. Billions of humans faked and shrugged their way through their education.

Now it is very clear who actually worked hard to understand what the teacher said, vs who never bothered.
